summary: 3D Object COMP that behaves like a real-world camera. A Render TOP renders the scene from this component's point of view, using its transform, projection, clipping, background, fog, light-mask, and render/pick priority settings.

common_gotchas: Scaling a camera's channels is not generally recommended; if scale is used, TouchDesigner tries to match the rendered output to the viewport as closely as possible.
Near and Far clipping planes control z-depth precision as well as visibility; reduce the near/far distance range, starting with the near plane, when z-depth artifacts appear.
For stable Look At rigs, use a Null Component as a center of interest, parent the camera as needed, and animate the Null instead of fighting camera rotations directly.
Camera Light Mask participates in Render TOP lighting decisions; multi-camera rendering can only share a pass when the cameras resolve to the same lights.
Custom Projection Matrix sources should produce Vulkan depth clip values in the [0,1] range, not OpenGL-style [-1,1] clip depth.
Render visibility is the logical AND of this component's Render parameter and its Render Flag, so both must allow rendering.
